 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ajay Digpaul
 Order
% 07.08.2025
1.
The present matter has been received by this Court at 4:30 PM today.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner, who is presently on interim bail granted on medical grounds, suffered a sudden deterioration in his health late last night,
experiencing a spike in blood pressure, vomiting, redness in the eyes, retro-orbital pain, anxiety,
severe headache, and fatigue, which led to his hospitalization.
In view of the same, learned counsel prays for an extension of the interim bail granted in FIR No. 210/2023, registered under Sections 420, 468, and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 07/08/2025 at 22:54:29 3.

The said interim bail was granted by this Court vide order dated 26.05.2025 and was subsequently extended vide order dated 24.07.2025 till today, i.e. 07.08.2025.
4.
As per the submissions made hereinabove, the interim bail is extended till 08.08.2025, on the same conditions as imposed by order dated 26.05.2025 of this Court.
